entries: I do not normally trust older folk, but solitude has taught me the value of friendship without the boundaries of bias.
我通常不信任上了年纪的人，可独处教会了我：友谊的价值，不该被偏见设限。
About our time together... let us take this up another time...
关于我们共度的时光……改天再谈吧……

I have no time for books. Good conversation is all that I need. A thousand books unwritten are found in the tales of men. And do I have some tales for you! Or... I would... if I could remember them...
我没时间看书。我需要的只是好谈话。人类的故事里，藏着千卷未写之书。我这里可有的是故事讲给你听！或者……本该是的……要是我还记得的话……
I cannot remember much other than being trapped down here. If I ever did know about them, I suppose I would have known exactly how to defeat them in battle.
除了被困在这下面，别的我记不得多少。要是我从前真了解他们，想必也早就知道该怎么在战斗中击败他们了。
People have dimensions too. You think you have figured them out, but there is always another angle. Uncovering that complexity is fun, and sometimes troubling.
人也有许多「维度」。你以为已经看透他们，却总还有另一个侧面。揭开这份复杂很有趣，有时也令人不安。
I have heard of them, but I doubt that such creatures exist. However, if they do, I am more than willing to take them on.
我听说过他们，但我怀疑这种生物是否存在。不过，若他们真的存在，我很愿意会一会。
There is an honesty about you that I cannot explain. I feel as though I should trust you. I don't trust some of the others, and perhaps they don't trust me either.
你身上有种我无法解释的坦荡。我觉得应该信任你。其余有些人，我并不信任，也许他们也不信任我。
There is a peace to graveyards that is not found elsewhere, even underground. But those most at rest are both in graveyards and underground.
墓地自有一种别处寻不到的安宁，连地下也没有。可最安眠的人，既在墓地，也在地下。
A nobleman's name for sure. Men such as myself have no need of secondary titles. If I am not enough to be known by my first name, then I am not worthy of being known.
确实是个贵族姓氏。像我这样的人，用不着什么附加的头衔。若我配不上让人记住本名，那我也不配被人认识。
I don't trust it, but I will use it to gain an advantage if I must.
我信不过它，但必要时，我会用它占得先机。
Solitude has been no friend to me. Darkness begets darkness...
独处从来不是我的朋友。黑暗滋生黑暗……
I spent too long in the dark reaches of the underground, and yet I still find myself compelled to dark places. Perhaps I am a broken man.
我在地下幽暗的深处待得太久，可仍不由自主地被黑暗之处吸引。也许我这人已经坏掉了。
Your light brings me comfort. I feel as though I have had many dark days, and any light or kindness is appreciated.
你的光让我安慰。我觉得自己经历过许多黑暗的日子，任何的光与善意，都让我心怀感激。
Know that I am a loyal companion. I will not abandon a fight, nor flee at the sight of danger.
记住，我是忠实的同伴。我不会临阵脱逃，也不会见险便跑。
If they tell stories as well as a bard, then I welcome their company. If one can read a story, then perhaps they can tell it.
若他们讲故事的功夫比得上吟游诗人，那我欢迎他们同行。一个人若能读故事，也许就能讲故事。
I am unaware of the importance of such a thing. Does not a fog come and go as it pleases? I am the same!
这种东西有什么要紧，我可不清楚。雾不就随心所欲地来去吗？我也一样！
I am a man of purpose. To slay that which haunts my dreams. That is my purpose.
我是个有目标的人。斩杀萦绕于梦中之物。那就是我的目标。

It is good that we found each other. Time spent without companionship can drain one's inner fire.

I speak of the bonds of friendship of course. Relationships are another issue altogether.

我们彼此相遇，是件好事。缺少同伴的时光，会耗尽内心的火焰。

当然，我说的是友谊的纽带。男女之情，则是另一回事。
I am not in this for that object. I follow you as a friend. Also, I get bored, and you find excitement. Actually... it finds you.
我掺和这事，不是为了那东西。我跟随你，因为我们是朋友。再说，我会无聊，而你总能遇到刺激。其实……是刺激总能找上你。
I may have once known something of it. It strikes a chord within my memory, and yet I cannot recall.
我从前也许知道它的一些事。它在我记忆深处拨动了一根弦，可我就是想不起来。

I find your music quite enchanting. For a long time I heard only the music of the earth. While beautiful, it was also haunting. Sometimes, I swore I even heard manmade music echoing up from the depths. Well, made by something alive anyways. I cannot imagine humans living so deep.
你的音乐让我着迷。很长一段时间里，我只听得见大地之乐。它固然美丽，却也萦绕心魂。有时，我甚至发誓听见深处有「人造」的音乐回荡，嗯，总之是活物弄出的声响。我无法想象人类会住在那么深的地方。
A fine name indeed. I much prefer when things have interesting names.
确实是好名字。我特别喜欢事物有有趣的名字。
Children's tales. Things that lurk in the dark... or perhaps the beast I am meant to slay is one of these Agmarians.
哄孩子的故事罢了。潜伏在黑暗里的东西……或者，我注定要斩杀的野兽，正是这些阿格玛人，之一。
There are many metals to be found in the dark. I wonder how many others we do not even know of.
黑暗中的金属多种多样。不知道还有多少种是我们闻所未闻的。
I know nothing of him, but I wonder who is more monstrous; him or his creations? Can a man, through some dark art, create something more evil than himself?
他我一无所知。不过我在想，谁更狰狞，是他，还是他的造物？一个人真能凭某种黑暗的技艺，造出比自己更邪恶的东西吗？
Few are as loyal a companion as a dog. It is great fortune that you and your master found me.
像狗这样忠诚的同伴，少之又少。你和你的主人找到我，是我莫大的幸运。
I struggle to see beyond the external in this situation. This partnership will be challenging for me, but it is a battle I am sure to win! Until then, I am watching.
这种情况下，我很难不被外表所限。这段同行对我将是挑战，但这场仗我一定能赢！在那之前，我会盯着。
I have no memory of that place. Will this Emerisk help me to find my quarry? Unlikely...
那地方我毫无记忆。这个埃梅里斯克能帮我找到我要猎杀的目标吗？恐怕不能……
